features.title: Draft an email from a short prompt
features.summary: Tell Copilot what the email should say and it writes a full draft. You then change the tone or length and keep it.
steps: Select Home, then New Mail.
Select the Copilot icon in the toolbar, then select Draft.
Type what the email should say in the Copilot box.
Select Generate (the arrow button).
Use Make it shorter, Make it longer or Change Tone, or select Retry for a new version.
Select Keep it, edit as needed, then select Send.
prompts: Let the team know we decided to use clay shingles and to go ahead so we meet the deadline.
Thank the client for today's meeting and confirm the next steps we agreed.
Politely ask the supplier for an update on the delayed order and a new delivery date.
limits: Steps above are for new Outlook for Windows. In classic Outlook, select Draft with Copilot, then Adjust, Regenerate and Keep. On Mac the buttons are Regenerate draft and Insert.
Legacy Outlook for Mac is not supported. Only the latest version has Copilot.
Not available on group mailboxes or mailboxes not hosted on Exchange Online.
Always read the draft. Microsoft says the output can be inaccurate or unexpected.

features.title: Summarise a long email thread
features.summary: Copilot reads the whole conversation and puts the key points at the top. Numbered links take you to the emails it used.
steps: Open the email conversation.
Select Summary by Copilot at the top of the thread. It may say Summarize.
Read the summary at the top of the email.
Select a numbered citation to jump to the matching message.
For attachments, select Summarize a file (new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web only).
prompts: Summary by Copilot (button, no prompt needed)
In Copilot Chat: Summarise the email thread about the supplier delay and list any actions for me.
In Copilot Chat: What decisions were made in this conversation?
limits: File summaries cover PDF, PowerPoint and Word files only.
On Mac, iOS and Android the summary is in the email's language by default. You can change it, but it resets when you restart Outlook.
Does not work on signed or encrypted emails (S/MIME, Double Key Encryption) or IRM emails.
On iOS and Android, tap the Copilot icon in the toolbar instead of the Summary box.

source.label: Summarize an email thread with Copilot in Outlook

features.title: Get coaching on a draft before you send
features.summary: Copilot reads your own draft and gives feedback on tone, clarity and how the reader may feel. You choose what to apply.
steps: Select Home, then New Mail, and write your message.
Select the Copilot icon, then choose Coaching by Copilot.
Read the notes on tone, clarity and reader sentiment.
Select Apply all suggestions, or make the edits yourself.
Send the email.
prompts: Coaching by Copilot (menu item, no prompt needed)
After coaching, ask Copilot: Make this sound warmer but keep it short.
After coaching, ask Copilot: Make the request clearer and put the deadline first.
limits: You need to have written a draft first. Coaching works on your text.
On mobile you can select Regenerate to get new feedback.
The page does not give a minimum length or list supported languages.
Not available on signed or encrypted emails.

source.label: Get email coaching with Copilot in Outlook

features.title: Turn an email thread into a meeting invite
features.summary: From an email, Copilot builds a meeting invitation with a title and agenda. It attaches the thread and adds the people on it.
steps: Open the email thread.
Select Schedule with Copilot in the toolbar.
Check the meeting title and agenda that Copilot fills in.
Check the attendees. Copilot adds the thread participants.
Edit if needed, then send the invitation.
prompts: In Copilot Chat: Schedule a 30 minute meeting with Sam and Priya next week.
In Copilot Chat: Add two hours of focus time on Thursday morning.
In Copilot Chat: Which days this week suit an office day for me?
limits: Schedule with Copilot is in new Outlook only.
Copilot Chat can schedule meetings with up to two other people, or add events such as focus time.
Prompts above are sensible examples, not quoted from the page. Check the invite before sending.

features.title: Summarise your notes
features.summary: Copilot summarises a page, a selection or a whole section. It works from typed text, handwriting and audio transcripts, and gives citations.
steps: Open the page you want to summarise.
On the Home tab, select Copilot. The pane opens on the right.
Type what you want in the compose box, such as key points or action items.
Select the Send arrow.
Select Copy to paste the result into OneNote or another app.
prompts: Summarize the notes on this page in chronological order of events, as bullet points.
Summarize this section and list the action items.
Summarize what was decided about the budget.
limits: Needs a Microsoft Copilot (Work) licence. Copilot may not appear if your organisation has not turned it on.
Copilot is unavailable in OneNote if Windows Information Protection is enabled on the device.
By default it summarises an entire section. Pick text or name a topic to narrow it.
Section and notebook level context is listed as coming soon on Mac, iPad, web and Teams.

source.label: Summarize your OneNote notes with Microsoft 365 Copilot

features.title: Make a to-do list from your notes
features.summary: Copilot turns your notes or a short request into a task list. You can use selected text or type the tasks.
steps: Select Copilot on the Home tab, or right-click selected text for quick actions.
Enter the tasks, deadlines or priorities.
Select Send.
Select Copy to reuse the list.
prompts: Draft a to-do list for a project meeting, including preparing the presentation, sending invites, and finalizing the agenda.
Create a task list from the selected text, with the most urgent first.
List the actions from this page and who owns each one.
limits: On Mac, iPad, web and Teams, Copilot answers from the current page, other Microsoft 365 files you can access, and the internet.
The on-canvas OneNote icon is only in OneNote for Microsoft 365.
Needs a Microsoft Copilot (Work) licence.

features.title: Rewrite text in a different tone
features.summary: Copilot rewrites your notes for tone, style, formality or length. You can ask for several versions.
steps: Select the text you want to change.
Select the Copilot icon menu, then Rewrite selected text. Or select Copilot on the Home tab and type Rewrite with details.
Select Send.
Select Copy to paste your chosen version.
prompts: Suggest 3 ways I could rewrite this text to sound more casual.
Rewrite this to be more formal and half the length.
Rewrite my meeting notes as clear sentences for a colleague who missed it.
limits: Rewrites can target tone, style, formality or length.
Needs a Microsoft Copilot (Work) licence.
Check the result. Copilot output can be wrong.

features.title: Get ideas or a draft plan
features.summary: Ask Copilot for ideas or a first plan for a task, then copy the result into your notebook.
steps: Select Copilot on the Home tab.
Type Give me ideas or Draft a plan, with details. Or select the View Prompt icon and choose Give me ideas for or Draft a plan.
Select Send.
Select Copy to paste it into your page.
prompts: Give me ideas of names for a team newsletter.
Draft a plan to prepare for next week's workshop.
Draft a plan to reduce my stress this week.
limits: Needs a Microsoft Copilot (Work) licence.
Web and Teams support is described as being rolled out.
Copilot features are still expanding, so buttons may change.

issues.text: Copilot cannot read S/MIME or Double Key Encryption emails. Signed, encrypted and IRM emails, and some sensitivity-labelled emails, are also excluded.
